latest_release.name: v3.4.4
latest_release.body:
Merged multiple pull requests, addressed upcoming compatibility issues with Typescript, and updated some dependencies.

## What's Changed
* Convert to type "module" and use package exports by @lkmill in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/432
* random should only return unit vector when scale is undefined by @marcusround in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/437
* Fix mat3.scale docs claiming to rotate input mat by @cedric-h in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/445
* use symmetric half up rounding in all vector modules. fixes #447 by @mreinstein in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/448
* Replace Math.hypot with Math.sqrt by @platypii in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/449
* Fix JSDoc types in quat.fromEuler by @Vlad-Shcherbina in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/454
* Improve the Performance of `vec4.random` by @Lakuna in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/458
* Fix order param type in quat.fromEuler by @shannon in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/461
* common: Add toDegree function for Consistency and Usability by @joaomariolago in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/463
* mat4.js JSDoc: quat4.toMat4 -> mat4.fromQuat by @pawplo in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/472
* JSDoc: missing function argument by @pawplo in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/473
* Minor Proofreading by @rotu in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/474
* Align docs with parameters names by @HarelM in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/475
* Fixes typos documentation comments in mat4.js by @LordArugula in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/479
* Fix return types of matrix invert functions by @ddadamhooper in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/481
* Fix build errors by locking dependencies by @hughsk-canva in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/480
* Run tests on push using GitHub Actions by @hughsk-canva in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/484
* Fix generated namespace types in index.d.ts by @robpalme in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/487
* Improved calculation of angles for vec2 by @GDOR-11 in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/490
* Optimized quaternion rotation routine by @infusion in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/476
* Feature: For `common.glMatrix` `equals` method added optional param `tolerance` by default equals to `EPSILON` by @psnet in https://github.com/toji/gl-matrix/pull/469
